name: p3-pointer-address-forms-baseline
text:
struct State { int prefix; int handle; }; extern struct State far state; extern struct State far otherState; extern int near choose; extern int far * far GetHandle(void); extern void far consume(int); extern void far KeepPointer(int far *);
{{FORM}}

FORM.local_far_scalar: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &state.handle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.local_far_struct: void far f(void) { struct State far *p; p = &state; if (p->handle != 0) { consume(p->handle); p->handle = 0; } }
FORM.local_far_index: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &state.handle; if (p[0] != 0) { consume(p[0]); p[0] = 0; } }
FORM.macro_scalar:
#define PTR p
void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &state.handle; if (*PTR != 0) { consume(*PTR); *PTR = 0; } }
FORM.pointer_returned: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = GetHandle(); if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.pointer_arithmetic: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &state.prefix + 1; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.conditional_assignment: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = (choose != 0) ? &state.handle : &otherState.handle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.passed_pointer: void far f(void) { int far *p; p = &state.handle; if (*p != 0) { KeepPointer(p); consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
FORM.based_pointer: void far f(void) { int __based(__segname("PACK")) *p; p = &state.handle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
